none: PAS LON-731A44: A base sherd fragment from a Roman Gaulish samian ware cup possibly Form Dragendorff 27g dating to AD 70-100.
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base sherd fragment from a Roman Gaulish samian ware cup possibly Form Dragendorff 27g dating to AD 70-100. The sherd has an external groove on the footring a feature found on 1st century examples. There is the remains of a maker's stamp with only one letter 'O' present. The fragment has a pink fabric and is coated in a red slip on both the inside and outside. Dimensions: length: 33.87mm;…
